text:
incident-bot: P0 pager: prod /v1/generate error spike after model rollout 'model:v2.3.3' -> elevated 5xx, token truncation reports, canary failing. Impacting a subset of realtime customers (acme-corp, beta-app). Paging oncall @anya.
Anya: ack I'm on it, grabbing logs/metrics now. tagging runtime + deploy.
Mike: looking at canary logs — seeing lots of tokenizer mismatch errors and early EOS tokens. example: `TokenizerError: token id 50256 out-of-range (vocab_size=50257)` and `KVCache misalign: shard 12 token_offset != expected`.
Lucy: if tokenizer/weights misaligned we should flip kill-switch for the rollout and abort canary immediately. Anyone confirm deploy flag name?
Sam: flag is `canary_rollout_v2`. I can flip it.
Anya: do it, then let's promote previous stable. Also start a rollback plan but keep canary lanes alive for verification.
Sam: running: ```bash
rdctl feature-flip --name canary_rollout_v2 --state off --env prod
```
deploy-bot: feature-flip acknowledged: canary_rollout_v2 -> off (actor: sam) :white_check_mark:
Mike: confirming traffic dropped to new variant, but some running hosts have loaded weights for v2.3.3; we'll need to evict caches on those nodes.
Lucy: rollback command ready: ```bash
rdctl model promote --from model:v2.3.2 --to prod --force --reason "tokenizer/weights mismatch on v2.3.3"
```
Anya: go ahead with promote, coordinate with eng-runtime to drain callers and refresh KV caches. Sam, can you throttle new requests while this runs?
Sam: throttling non-essential traffic by 40% now, prioritized SLAs left at full.
Mike: running cache eviction on affected pools: ```bash
rdctl nodes exec --pool canary-pool --cmd "pkill -USR2 inferd; rdctl cache-clear --all"
``` Logs show `cache-clear OK` on 6/6 nodes.
deploy-bot: promote started (task id: promote-4332). progress: 0% -> 55% -> 100%. :rocket:
Lucy: nice. once promote finishes, run a small smoke suite against prod endpoint to verify tokens and length distribution.
Irene: support note — acme-corp reported truncated responses in their pipeline, CS on it. I'll send a brief status update to their CSM and ask for any affected timestamps.
Mike: smoke tests against prod after promote: sample prompts returning expected length and no TokenizerError. e.g. `> prompt: explain pagination` -> response length 213 tokens, no truncation.
Anya: confirmed metrics trending back to baseline: 5xx rate down to normal, p95 latency stable. Good job team.
Lucy: filing post-incident: assign to runtime+deploy for root cause (weightset aliasing + deploy metadata drift). Also put a mitigation: make model package verification step mandatory in rollout pipeline.
Irene: logging customer impact for SLA review and outreach.
Anya: handing off to incident-retrospect channel for follow-up. closing pager. :spiral_note_pad: 
Mike: quick note — found root cause: build pipeline published artifact with mismatched tokenizer metadata (artifact tag mismatch between weights and tokenizer). adding checksum sanity check to pipeline PR.
deploy-bot: pager resolved (incident-4332101111), postmortem required.
Lucy: thanks all. follow-up owners: Mike (runtime fix), Sam (deploy pipeline guard), Lucy (postmortem + communications).
Anya: thanks everyone, back to regular oncall.
